prefill_capture_seq_lens size: 80
decode_capture_batch_sizes size: 0
disable_dpc_random: 0
rocm_disable_custom_ag1

[DeviceResourceConfig]
device_reserve_memory_bytes: -4096000000
host_reserve_memory_bytes: 4294967296
overlap_math_sm_count: 0
overlap_comm_type: 0
m_split: 0
enable_comm_overlap: 1
enable_layer_micro_batch: 0
not_use_default_stream: 0

[MoeConfig]
use_deepep_moe: 0
use_deepep_internode: 0
use_deepep_low_latency: 0
use_deepep_p2p_low_latency: 0
fake_balance_expert: 0
hack_moe_expert: 0
deep_ep_num_sm: 0
max_moe_normal_masked_token_num: 1024
use_all_gather: 1

[ModelSpecificConfig]
max_lora_model_size: -1
load_python_model:0


[SpeculativeExecutionConfig]
model_type: 
type: none
sp_min_token_match: 2
sp_max_token_match: 2
tree_decode_config: 
gen_num_per_cycle: 1
force_stream_sample: 0
force_score_context_attention: 1
quantization: 
checkpoint_path: 
use_new_sp_engine: 0

[CacheStoreConfig]
cache_store_rdma_mode: 0
wrr_available_ratio: 80
rank_factor: 0
thread_count: 16
rdma_connect_timeout_ms: 250
rdma_qp_count_per_connection: 2
rdma_io_thread_count: 4
rdma_worker_thread_count: 2
messager_io_thread_count: 2
messager_worker_thread_count: 16


[MiscellaneousConfig]
disable_pdl: 1
aux_string: 


[ArpcConfig]
threadNum: 10
queueNum: 50
ioThreadNum: 2

[LoadConfig]
load_method: auto
